نُفَاثَةٌ What one blows, or spits, (يَنْفِثُ,) from his mouth. (S.) ―
-b2- What a person having a disease in his chest blows forth or spits out, يَنْفِثُ. (K.) ―
-b3- What remains in one's mouth, of a سِوَاك, or tooth-stick, and is spit out: (S:) a particle broken off (شَظِيَّةٌ: so in the L &c.: in the K, شَطِيبَةٌ:) from a سواك, or tooth-stick, remaining in the mouth, and spit out. (L, K.) One says, لَوْ سَأَلَنِى نُفَاثَةَ سِوَاكٍ مَا أَعْطَيْتُهُ If he asked me for a particle of a tooth-stick, remaining in my mouth, I would not give him (it). (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
